correction.observed_failure: The remote.2 runner still populated its exact-revision source cache through the Mac network before transferring the checkout to Spark.
correction.effect: Repository acquisition failures could censor an episode before the Agent or Spark execution backend started.
correction.change: Populate, lock, validate, and fsck the immutable exact-revision Git cache on Spark; return the verified checkout over Tailscale and reuse the same Spark checkout for construction.

source_cache_invariants: The cache is keyed by repository and exact revision under the configured Spark workspace root.
Cache population is protected by a host-side flock and published only after exact commit validation and git fsck.
Every cache hit is revalidated against refs/envsolve/exact and git fsck.
Each episode receives an independent no-hardlinks checkout.
The checked-out HEAD must equal the case revision before the workspace is transferred to Mac or mounted into Docker.
No model credential or Codex executable is transferred to Spark.

verification.ruff: not rerun because ruff is not installed in the active Mac interpreter; remote.2 scoped Ruff had passed before this source-cache-only correction
